---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to an existing module or the core
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do that biolic makes hard or impossible today?

## Proposed solution

What flag, behavior, or change would solve it? If it's a new flag, suggest a
name and what it does.

## Alternatives

How do you work around it now (other tools, scripts)?

## Notes

Anything else — references to how `nanoq` / `chopper` / `seqkit` handle it is
helpful.
